notes.title: Four Years of Squeaky Wheel
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35884729/4df755604d0e695f008e9bc669d1703af28befd0.png[/img]

Four years ago on this month, Tristan, Marnel and I became officially registered as Squeaky Wheel Studio Inc.We’ll be taking a break today and having dinner with some of our gamedev friends to celebrate, but in the meantime let me take a walk down memory lane.

[h1]September 2015[/h1]

I am at EGX 2015 for the launch of Prison Architect.  The IVSoftware team have kindly flown me and my wife over to celebrate the launch, so I use this as a way to pitch our game Political Animals to publishers.  I meet Cliffski for the first time and pitch the game to him.  

Within a couple of days he offers me a publishing deal.  Anyone who has done a publishing deal before will know that this is an extraordinarily short amount of time to get a deal done.  It helps that we got along and Cliffski is a one-man show studio that answers to no one, but still.

[h1]October 2015[/h1]

After landing back in Manila I immediately set about establishing a company, which is not a trivial process in the Philippines.  I end up paying more than I probably needed to in order to have another company help me set up my company, such is life here. We are officially registered with the SEC by October 28, 2015

Funny aside, I had thought that we had incorporated on October the 15, which is why we are celebrating our anniversary today. :P

[h1]November 2016[/h1]

After almost a year of working nonstop on Political Animals and taking it to conventions like BICfest, TGS, and PAX, we release the game.  Even with all the advantages that we had, it is a flop. 

[h1]September 2017[/h1]

A mere 10 months later, we launch Academia : School Simulator in Early Access.  It succeeds well enough to save the company and we continue development of the game.

[h1]October 2019[/h1]

It has been a little over 2 years since Early Access launch, and 3 years since initial development of Academia.  We have hit many highs and lows, but the game continues to make enough income to support our team.

[h1]<October 2020[/h1]

This brings me to an announcement from the future.  At some point before October 2020, we want to launch version 1 of Academia : School Simulator.  The game has made major strides since it first came out.  While there is still more work to be done, we can finally see the finish line.  

Games like Academia : School Simulator are tricky things. While there is the potential to build on it infinitely, we believe we’re coming close to a point that we are personally satisfied with it.  Version 1 doesn’t necessarily mean the end of development, but it does mean a change of focus for the team. It’s been a long road, and we’re excited to slowly inch our way to something new, whatever that may be.

Spoiler Alert, we have some exciting news coming up soon, so stay tuned!

[h1]Thanks to Everyone[/h1]

We want to thank everyone that has supported us throughout this journey.  Thanks to everyone who has played the game (if you enjoyed your experience please write us a review because it really matters!).  Thanks to our partners, our parents and families for supporting us.  Thanks to our fellow devs, streamers, and publishers for supporting us, spreading the word, and putting your faith in us.  

We hope that you’ll stick around for the years to come!

notes.title: Our new game Academia : School Simulator has been launched!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/1fe54d3483b60b2ce7446e34d9c5710e6d84ab31.jpg[/img]

As some of you might know we started working on a new game a few months after Political Animals launched.

After 9 months of hard work, we’re very pleased to finally be able share Academia : School Simulator with you all! I’ll keep this short and sweet as we are exhausted and already mentally preparing for your support emails!

For our Early Access launch of Academia we have 4 different tiers of the game that you can purchase, with corresponding benefits.  I’ll go over them very quickly here.

[h1]$20 Base Game[/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/a701b6c359c7d0a39ab275dfafffb662811bbb82.jpg[/img]

This gets you a copy of Academia School Simulator.  Thanks for supporting us!

[h1]$25 Political Animals Bundle[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/6caa21927609479b323ebf73d706e7608db33265.jpg[/img]

If you have already bought Political Animals, you get 20% off on Academia even after the Launch sale!

[h1]$35 Name in Game[/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/74486766a43d102880c64b34e10ad1085a6cd8c1.jpg[/img]

You get all the above plus your name in the game!  You can only get this using the humble widget. (Steam keys provided)

[h1]$200 Custom Teacher Sprite[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30448709/d798a1c1ebc742256de8e5eb8bb5b32881fcb78b.jpg[/img]

You get all the above plus a customized teacher sprite made in your image! You can only get this using the humble widget. (Steam keys provided)

[h1]Launch Sale![/h1] 

All tiers have a launch week sale of 20% off, except for the custom teacher sprite, which is only 10% off.

Thanks so much guys, hope you enjoy the game, and we’ll be in touch soon!  For fans of Political Animals (we know you're out there!) this means that we won't be working on the game anytime soon.  But if Academia is a successful game, that means we can hire some people to help out with development of Political Animals, so please help us spread the word!

notes.title: Campaign head-to-head with a friend! Political Animals now has local multiplayer!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26586260/1517717af049fb9c813b87fe757ea23e07ccd3f4.jpg[/img]

Hello citizens!
 
We’ve listened to your demands and we finally made it happen! Political Animals now has local multiplayer and more! Thank you to everyone who gave their feedback and suggestions, we couldn’t have done this without you.  
 
[h1]Local Multiplayer[/h1]

Why argue over your political differences if you can fight it out in a no-holds barred political campaign?  Two player mode is where your true political colors come out, with you and a friend trash-talking each other all the way to the polling stations.  Do you think you can make it through the election campaign with your morals intact?  There’s only one way to find out!

[h1]New Map: Pink Island[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26586260/a28d6427519f7a9704aae72cdc541aaab721dcfd.png[/img]

The French presidential elections are coming soon, and what better way to celebrate than to add a new map for our players in France! This land of love is no stranger to salacious scandals, so let the citizens eat cake while you lead your opponent to the political guillotine.

[h1]Interesting New Traits![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26586260/0290c49156303bf01371e0867f9cf3a854c0842e.gif[/img]

Do you fancy running as a Donkey Demagogue or a Lazy Lion? We’ve added some new traits so you can make even more unique and customized candidates!  The traits include : Inquisitive, Community Leader, Demagogue, Lazy, Salesman, and Irresponsible!

Once again, thanks for playing everyone! Stay tuned for more and always feel free to reach out to us for anything you want to know or share.

notes.title: Political Animals Launches Linux version!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26586260/bf0a932db49ad01822b109e8d4fc99905f8661e5.png[/img]

Hey everyone, we're excited to announce some awesome updates to Political Animals!

[h1] Linux Version [/h1] 

We're happy to finally be able to release the game on Linux!  Thanks so much to the folks on r/linux_gaming/ for their help in testing the game on multiple distros.  We hope you enjoy the game.

There are a few known issues with Linux which we have shared in our community page.  Please let us know if you find any issues and we'll do our best to sort them out.

[h1] Quick Play [/h1] 

We always imagined Political Animals to be the bite-sized strategy game that you play in between grueling rounds of Crusader Kings 2 or Civilization VI.  That's been further reinforced with Quick Play.  Now regular players of Political Animals who just want a quick fix can simply click on the Quick Play button on the main screen and take on a random campaign.  

In the settings menu you can set the parameters for your quick play sessions, setting the difficulty, campaign length, and starting campaign funds. 

[h1] New Candidates! [/h1] 

We've added the Penguin, Otter, Ferret, and Reindeer (for a little holiday cheer) to our roster of candidates!  If your favorite animal isn't yet available, feel free to request for one and we'll get on it!

Thanks for playing everyone!  We'll have more updates soon so stay tuned!

*WARNING - One of our players has noted that their saves have been lost following the update.  If you have previously downloaded the game please wait until we resolve this issue before updating.  Sorry about that.

notes.title: Political Animals Update 2
notes.content:
Hi all, just announcing a quick update to address some issues. This release includes:

- Bug fixes
- Fixed crash on finish of North Island
- Fixed localization related bugs
- Pause after election such that players can take screenshots
- Settings are now saved (your language and sound/volume setting will be saved until you change them)

As usual we would greatly appreciate any feedback/bug report on our Steam community page.
